objective: Take up LOOP-ANY-20261108-001's direction 1, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-08 (G5 with G1): networks of loops, rings with three or more contacts. Give one ring a third contact so that two loops share it, find the balance condition for each loop, and stop at persistence of every contact at every size or at the obstruction where the loops meet.
status: Complete 2026-11-08: proved that in networks of rule-60 rings a contact keeps its witnesses at every lag exactly when its returns in the contact graph cancel; the positions embed the rings in a surface, and in a uniform network (every ring and face of one density) the returns cancel iff every return count is even; a symmetry exchanging a contact's rings cancels them, so loops, two rings sharing m contacts, the Platonic networks and square, triangular and honeycomb lattices of rings on a torus persist at every size; where a two-contact ring meets a ring of more contacts one short return is unpaired (figure-eights, chords), and a census of 170,502 placements at equal ring sizes found no other cancellation. Recommendation Continue (composition and separation across a lattice of rings).
stop_rule: Stop with every contact persistent at every size in networks whose loops share rings, or with the obstruction at the contacts where loops meet.
